name: Inverse-Volatility Portfolio
description: Weights each asset proportionally to the inverse of its trailing volatility (Leote de Carvalho, Lu & Moulin 2012) — the simplest risk-based allocation, no covariance or optimization. A robust naive-diversification baseline distinct from the full equal-risk-contribution RiskParityStrategy (which uses the covariance matrix). Long-only, weights sum to 1.
